spec_match.rationale: Eight cases map to decided design-space answers and exact spec steps: primitive rejection for both the argument and elements (reject-primitives), zero inputs already-completed, invalid mode TypeError, non-object padding TypeError, strict mid-iteration TypeError after the aligned prefix, shortest closing remaining inputs, and consumer return() closing all open inputs in reverse (IteratorCloseAll order) — each verified to match real V8 15.0 in the differential test.

interactive.rationale: A single run-all action executes all eight instrumented cases live and renders observed behavior plus a spec-vs-observed verdict per row; nothing is prewritten.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises the rejection and cleanup contract including reverse-order closing, which is exactly what runs.

edge_cases.rationale: This concept is the edge/failure portfolio slot; it additionally teaches the intentional-wrapping escape hatch ([..."abc"]) for the string rejection.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/6249068542164992, the proposal's considered-design-space section, and the IteratorZip algorithm.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite mirrors the lab (zip-rejects-string-argument, zip-rejects-string-element, zip-invalid-mode-throws, zip-zero-inputs-done, zip-strict-mismatch-throws-typeerror, zip-shortest-closes-remaining), each guarded to fail rather than vacuously pass without the statics; all verified on real V8 15.0.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven headlessly via CDP (page-driver zip-edges, Chromium 141, 2026-08-16): 8 of 8 rows report matches-spec in the labelled model path, including finally order [a, b] for shortest closure and [b, a] for consumer return() (reverse order); zero console errors, zero failed requests. Screenshots: zip-edges.png (desktop), m-zip-edge-lab.png (mobile 360, post-interaction, scrollWidth 360). Native-path equivalence for every case pinned by the 29-check differential test on V8 15.0.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts zip-edge-lab-core-contract (passCount === 8) with native/model detail after the run, plus the shared banner-honesty assert; every expected TypeError is caught so the console stays clean.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; verdict colours accent-emerald/accent-rose on bg-paper; table headers bg-stone on text-black; button keeps the paired colour override.

accessibility.rationale: Case names are th scope=row in a captioned table; the run button is native with visible focus and 44px height; the summary is role=status; the scrollable wrapper is focusable with an explanatory aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The four-column table wraps long tokens (overflow-wrap:anywhere) inside its own scroll container; scrollWidth 360 at mobile emulation post-interaction (m-zip-edge-lab.png); feature responsive-check mobile OK.

openQuestions.title: Cover error-propagation priority (first error swallows subsequent)
openQuestions.detail: The design-space records that when an input fails to advance, remaining inputs are still closed and the FIRST error wins (no AggregateError). The lab covers closing on completion and consumer return(), but not a mid-round next() throw racing a second failing input. A ninth case with two throwing iterators would pin the first-error-wins rule; verify intended behavior against the native implementation first.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic result updates screen reader live region output element
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Result matrices belong in semantic tables with caption/th scoping; dynamic pass-count summaries belong in status live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The results table has a caption, column scopes, and row-scoped case names; the pass-count summary is role=status updated after each run.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls table layout narrow mobile viewport no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep wide tabular content in an overflow-x:auto container with wrapping cells so the page body never scrolls horizontally on mobile.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .table-wrap { overflow-x:auto } with tabindex=0 and aria-label; td/th use overflow-wrap:anywhere; verified scrollWidth 360 at 360x740.

summary: Edge/failure angle: eight live cases executing the committee's decided answers — primitive rejection both levels, zero-input completion, option validation, strict's partial-output-then-TypeError, and the closing protocol including reverse-order IteratorCloseAll — with observed-vs-spec verdicts per row. Verified headlessly on Chromium 141 in the labelled spec-model path; native equivalence pinned by the V8 15.0 differential test.
